text:
Today that you have returned, we both were silent,

and only our old thoughts

lit the sweet darkness

of being together and saying nothing.


Only our hands clasped so tightly

as if breaking the iron of absence.

If only a cloud would eclipse our lives!


Leave in my heart the new voices,

the very clear, present assault

of your person upon the landscapes

that are in me for the air of your life.

translation.title: Today That You Have Returned, We Both Were Silent
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the reunited silence and hands breaking the iron of absence.
